guardrails.gentle-illustration-reveal: Only a real authored visible illustration/graphic state change, not an imaginary UI action; actual audio quality needs later listening QA.
guardrails.verified-product-screen-reveal: Only original authentic UI screenshot entrance; this is a visual reveal, NOT proof the app was clicked or completed an operation.
guardrails.real-ui-press: Requires explicit verified screen recording/capture metadata proving a visible physical tap; text or static image alone is not proof.
guardrails.verified-success-state: Requires explicit verified product state transition to a real success state; do not imply app payment, installation, achievement or answer if not proven.

lessonEditorialLimits: Follow content/EDITING_SPEC.md and numeric sound limits only in content/visual-system.json#sound; do not add opening hook cues or compete with Chinese pronunciation.
phase3Timing: P3 implemented as explicit local TEST ONLY metadata binder (scripts/codex-soundkit-bind.mjs): validates current approved voice profile, actual imported audio byte SHA-256, exact episode cue-timeline.json, original scene visual events, word anchor, chosen sound SHA-256, and independent shared/TikTok voice/CTA. No P4 audio mixing or production render integration. Real Gemini voice-linked QA still required before P4.
phase4Rendering: Not implemented: no SFX selection is applied to Remotion/HyperFrames, and no renderer reads this policy yet.
publicity: TEST ONLY / unapproved audio reference catalog / no authorization to publish
interactionReviewGate: P2 must not suggest actual click/success sounds even when future authors mark an interaction as verified; independent source-media hash/provenance review belongs to P3+.
